title: Chapter 769 Fire Spirit Mystic Realm; Heavenly Soul Pearl!
content:
Chapter 769 Fire Spirit Mystic Realm; Heavenly Soul Pearl!

Chapter 769 Fire Spirit Mystic Realm; Heavenly Soul Pearl!

Ten years passed in the blink of an eye.

The current Fire God Palace and Water God Palace could be said to be quite powerful.

They were like two super machines. Once they were activated, even a needle in the ocean could detect the relevant information.

On this day, Lin Fan, who was in the midst of his cultivation, suddenly heard a shout in his mind.

"Master!"

Lin Fan sensed it and knew that it was Li Ke calling him.

Thus, he initiated soul communication with it.

"Master, I've found some information about the Orb," said Li Ke respectfully.

"Oh?" Lin Fan's eyes lit up.

"According to a star level kid, he saw a red orb in the Fire Spirit Secret Realm of Fenglai Star in the Clear Spring Region of the Heavenly Wind Universe a hundred years ago," Li Ke said.

Star level?

Little guy?

In the world of cultivators, the strong were respected.

As the Fire God Palace's Palace Master, Li Ke indeed had the right to address him as such.

Lin Fan said," Not bad!"

Although it was only a short compliment, Li Ke was ecstatic.

Finally, he had done something for his master and received praise!

Lin Fan asked," Li Ke, what's your cultivation level now?"

"Master, I'm now at Emperor level 5." Li Ke hurriedly said.

Emperor level 5!

In just a few hundred years, he had reached the fifth level of the Imperial level.

This kind of speed could not be said to not be fast!

One of the reasons for this was because Lin Fan had imparted him with a profound cultivation technique.

In addition, Zhu Sen, who was a Sacred Lord, had given him a lot of help. He had been able to stay in a secret realm where time flowed a thousand times faster than the outside world for a hundred years!

Lin Fan nodded," I will explain the comprehension of the fire attribute skills. Listen carefully."

"Yes, Master!" Li Ke said excitedly.

This lecture lasted for half a month.

Every time Lin Fan explained, Li Ke was enlightened.

This time was no exception.

Not long ago, Li Ke had reached a bottleneck.

Now, it was all clear.

Li Ke had a very real feeling that as long as he absorbed enough energy, perhaps it would not be long before he could break through again!

" Thank you, Master!" Li Ke knelt on the ground and said respectfully.

Lin Fan said," Continue working hard."

After saying that, he ended the soul communication.

Lin Fan looked at Hu Tian, Su Ningjing, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the others who were cultivating quietly in the Coiling Dragon Villa. He didn't disturb them.

Following that, he took a step forward according to the universe map in his memory.

"Whoosh!"

With a single step, it was the Cang Ocean Cang Tian.

In the next moment, Lin Fan appeared in the void that was extremely far away.

"Whoosh!"

Stepping out once more, the surrounding meteorites rushed forward. With a slight thought, the meteorites turned into ashes.

"Whoosh!"

He took another step forward, and above his head was a scorching star that could melt steel in an instant.

....

In the blink of an eye, five days had passed.

Lin Fan finally stopped.

In front of him was a planet with clear water and blue sky. It was a rather poetic planet.

This... It was Fenglai Planet.

The car sped along the road.

In the sky, the flying devices crisscrossed.

Lin Fan guessed that the technology here should be behind Earth.

Lin Fan found a restaurant. As he savored the delicacies, he spread out a huge amount of his mental power.

Instantly, the discussions of countless people and the entire Fenglai Planet appeared in Lin Fan's mind.

"I won 10 million!"

" I've finally broken through!"

"Don't use so much strength. Ah, it hurts. Slow down, slow down..."

....

Countless pieces of information were being filtered through Lin Fan's mind.

After a while, he heard what he wanted.

"Have you heard? There was an earthquake on Fire Spirit Mountain yesterday. Many rocks rolled down and killed many people."

"Another earthquake? That's really not a good place."

"Who says so! It's best not to go there in the future."

....

"According to my speculation, the Fire Spirit Mystic Realm will open soon."

"This time, I must gain something!"

"I heard that someone directly became a star level warrior last time!"

....

When Lin Fan heard this, he gathered his mental power and ate some more food before stepping out.

"Whoosh!"

In the next moment, he appeared in front of a continuous mountain range.

According to the information obtained by his spiritual power, this was the entrance to the Fire Spirit Mystic Realm.

Not too far away, a man dressed in green robes noticed Lin Fan and called out," Fellow Daoist, do you want to enter the Fire Spirit Secret Realm too?"

Lin Fan nodded," Not bad."

"Then I'm afraid you're a little early. There was a slight earthquake here yesterday, and the spiritual energy didn't spread too much. According to past experience, it will take at least half a month to open." the green-robed man said.

Lin Fan did a quick calculation and knew that he was right.

However, Lin Fan didn't want to wait. He smiled," Sometimes, there are exceptions."

As soon as he finished speaking.

"Rumble!"

The continuous mountain peaks suddenly shook violently.

In the next moment, the mountain peak in the middle cracked open, revealing a dazzling white crack.

Surging spiritual energy rolled out from the crack, forming a powerful spiritual energy tide. It blew against the man's clothes, causing them to rustle. The surrounding trees and flowers kept swaying.

Lin Fan said," Look, an exception has appeared, right?"

After saying that, he turned into a stream of light and flew straight into the Fire Spirit Mystic Realm.

"Fellow Daoist, wait for me!" The green-robed man was stunned for a moment.

As soon as he finished speaking, he hurriedly followed.

This place…It was a dense forest with vines and venomous snakes.

Lin Fan scanned his surroundings. There was no trace of the pearl within ten thousand miles.

He understood that the pearl should not be in the secret realm.

The green robed man saw that Lin Fan didn't move. He said," My name is Kaien. May I know who you are?"

"Lin Fan." Lin Fan said.

Kaien said," Fellow Daoist Lin, I've been to the Fire Spirit Secret Realm twice. I'm quite familiar with this place. Why don't we explore it together?"

" Don't worry, I'm only here to find the Heavenly Soul Fruit. I can give you the rest of the treasures."

Lin Fan could tell that Kaien wasn't lying and was extremely sincere.

Lin Fan thought about how he had spent a few days rushing over.

Now that there was nothing much to do, it was not bad to take a stroll and admire the scenery of the other world.

"Alright," he nodded.

The two of them walked forward. Along the way, all the ferocious beasts they encountered were killed by Kane.

As for the traps that were hidden in the dark, they were all obliterated by Lin Fan.

Therefore, this trip to the Fire Spirit Mystic Realm could be said to be very easy.

And just like what he said, Kaien gave all the treasures to Lin Fan.

As time passed, a look of disappointment gradually appeared on Kane's face.

That was because he had never found the Heavenly Soul Fruit that he needed.
